verdict.rationale: ClickUp's marketing explicitly claims "Build your own agent" alongside a Super Agent and prebuilt agents (Codegen, Triage), so the story's core capability is asserted first-party. The only support is headline-level copy, with no documentation of how users create or configure an agent. Missing for 10: documentation of the agent builder and its configuration options (instructions, tools, triggers, knowledge sources, model choice), and hands-on or independent corroboration that custom agents work as claimed.
